cards.title: Exact LIS and EIS sequence sums
cards.role: Converts the paper's schedules to exact query counts and Fisher bounds.

source_refs.value: Sec. 3.2, LIS/EIS bullet list and following paragraph

cards.latex: \begin{aligned}N_{q}^{\rm LIS}&=N_{\rm shot}(M+1)^2, &\sum N_k(2m_k+1)^2&=\frac{N_{\rm shot}(M+1)(2M+1)(2M+3)}{3},\\N_q^{\rm EIS}&=N_{\rm shot}(2^{M+1}+M-1), &\sum N_k(2m_k+1)^2&=N_{\rm shot}\left[\frac{4^{M+1}-4}{3}+2^{M+2}+M-3\right].\end{aligned}

checks.reason: Arithmetic and geometric sums are derived independently and checked term-by-term for M=0..12.
Both schedules reduce to one m=0 circuit and N_q=N_shot at M=0.

cards.numerical_form: lis: m=arange(M+1); eis: m=[0]+[2**(k-1) for k in 1..M]; sums are checked against direct enumeration

cards.title: Conventional amplitude-estimation error envelope
cards.role: Provides the deterministic conventional comparator in Fig. A.

source_refs.value: Appendix A, paragraph defining the four nearest integers

cards.latex: Q_m=2^m-1,\quad y\in\{\lfloor Q_m\theta_a/\pi\rfloor,\lceil Q_m\theta_a/\pi\rceil,Q_m-\lfloor Q_m\theta_a/\pi\rfloor,Q_m-\lceil Q_m\theta_a/\pi\rceil\},\quad e_m=\max_y\left|\sin^2(\pi y/Q_m)-a\right|.

checks.reason: sin^2(pi-y)=sin^2(y), so the two phase branches give the same amplitude candidates.
Nearest-grid phase error is O(1/Q_m), hence amplitude error vanishes with queries.

cards.numerical_form: evaluate floor/ceil candidates on both symmetric phase branches and retain the largest absolute amplitude error
